speech.heard: In Tajikistan, personal remittances received reach 58% of gross domestic product. The map uses dark blue for the lowest values, moving through grey gold to bright yellow for the highest across 173 countries and territories. Tajikistan is the highest at 58%. India is 4% and the USA is 0%. Personal remittances comprise personal transfers and compensation of employees, counting cash and in-kind transfers plus income of short-term and border workers. So where does your country rank on the map?
